0022600225.text: The Golden State Warriors (8-3, 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back) carry an eight-game winning streak into this 12th game of the season, while the Houston Rockets (8-3, 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back) enter on a one-game win streak. Out for the Warriors are Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee, inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and out for the Rockets are Clint Capela (ankle, sprain) and Steven Adams (calf, strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 117-116 Warriors loss in San Francisco on April 5, 2026, while the 2025-26 season series ended with the Warriors losing 1-2.
